data.description:
**New weapon:** the **AK12** assault rifle in **5.45x39mm**! Also, a sunny **surprise** for X-mas! Previously: **XM7** new US battle rifle, **XM157** auto-ranging scope, **Mosin Nagant, GP25.**

Shoot more than **35 weapons** at various targets in this fun sandbox range! Blast and fight in **120 fps** with accurate ballistics and weapon mechanics, at our target-rich farm!
{1084690026324471}

**Assault rifles**: XM7 - M4 - AKM/AK47 - AK12 - L85a3 - G36C - FN SCAR-H

**Support**: M249 SAW LMG - M203 40mm & GP25 40mm under-barrel launchers - M67 Hand grenade - M18 Smoke grenade

**Submachineguns**: FN P90 - MAC-10 - MP5A3 - MP5SD - Thompson M1928A1

**Rifles**: AR-15 - Dragunov - Barrett M107 .50-cal - M24 bolt action - CZ .22LR - AWM .300 - Mosin Nagant 7.62x54R

**Shotguns**: SPAS-12 - Benelli M4 - Mossberg S/S - Beretta O/U - "Mad Max" - Sawn-off pump - AA12

**Handguns**: M1911 - Glock 17 - Desert Eagle - Beretta M9 - Glock 44 - Beretta 93R - Colt Python (6- and 2.5-inch) - S&W TRR8

**Optics, scopes, bipods, lasers and suppressors** can be fitted, and firing modes selected.

{3938240939744884}

**Short** and **long** ranges with:
- scarecrows that hunt you, and big bosses,
- an item spawner,
- plinking, spinning, and destructible targets,
- scoring targets, moving or stationary,
  (bullseye, IPSC, silhouette targets)
- clays, trap, and skeet,
- chickens, hogs & a truck,
- a pumpkin launcher,
- a ShootBarn - clear the corridors,
- a 3-gun range,
and more!


{444441191975304}

https://discord.gg/r3JYKWMYME

reddit.com/r/gunsgame

120 Hz works if enabled! Install size ~160MB.

Free demo - GUNSdemo!

changelog.change_log:
V. 1,004: Bugfix update!
Boss escape bug fix, monster inattention bug improved!
Also: New handgun optic - NcSTAR with green crosshair!

V. 0.998 - End of year update! 
- The AK12 assault rifle in 5.45x39mm!
- Fun in the sun at Sandy Farm! 
- Muzzle flashes now light up the environment. 
==== 
Also bug fixes, graphical tweaks. 
Known issue: Haptic effects occasionally fail to start. Pausing the game, touching a menu button, and unpausing, will restart them.

V. 0.997: X-mas update!

The AK12 assault rifle in 5.45x39mm!
A surprise package for fun in the sun!
Muzzle flashes now light up the environment.
====
Also bug fixes, graphical tweaks.
Known issue: Haptic effects occasionally fail to start.
Pausing the game, touching a menu button, and unpausing, will restart them.

V. 0.992: November update!

* New weapon! The new US battle rifle - the XM7 in .277 Fury!
* Also, the new XM157 auto-ranging 1x-8x variable optic!
====
- Bug fix for small scarecrows not sinking properly when killed.

V 0.976: Halloween update!

* New weapon: the Mosin Nagant WW1 rifle, in 7.62x54R!
* Ghost scarecrows, 
* Scarecrow waves,
* Quest 3 controller models.

=========

Fixes: Cartridge style for Dragunov rifle.

V. 0.958:
- New weapon: the **Beretta 93R machine pistol**! 93R, for "Raffica" or burst, was developed for the Italian police and armed forces for counter-terrorist use.
- New object: **Riot shield**!
- New monster: the **Scarecrow Boss**! 

===

Fixes: graphical tweaks.

V. 0.944 (quick update from 0.940):

New weapon: the FN Herstal SCAR-H automatic rifle, 7.62x51 NATO!

===

Also bug fixes for suppressor sounds, graphics glitches, a fire mode oddity and SCAR lockback.

V. 0.932:

New weapons:
- Smith&Wesson TRR8 revolver, .357 Magnum
- Colt Python 2.5in snubnose revolver, .357 Magnum

=====

- Bug fix: body collider glitch.

V. 0.916: July 4th update!

New weapons: 
- AWM sniper rifle, .300 Win Magnum! 
- Also M18 smoke grenades & T2 optics on more handguns!
===
Fixes: Scarecrow aiming, barn door, pistol mag drop oddities.

V. 0.887: Assault rifle update!
- New weapon: H&K G36C assault rifle, 5.56!
- Test: T2 red dot on Desert Eagle
===
Bug fixes: Teleport bug fixed (at last!), pot shard shaking bug.

Update V. 0.865:

- New weapon: .22lr plinking rifle,
- New item spawner,

Bug fix for optics not appearing correctly on ungrabbed handguns.

Bug fix update:

- Hogs are now mortal again - a bug stopped them being hit correctly,
- The bullet link on the M249 could be duplicated and hang weirdly in certain circumstances, now fixed.

Previous update:
SAW update for GUNS: the M249 LMG!

- New weapon: the M249 5.56x45 Light Machine Gun,
- New machine gun targets,
- New hIt indicators.


=====

Known issues: teleporting may sometimes require two button presses.

SAW update for GUNS: the **M249 LMG**!

- New weapon: the **M249 5.56x45** Light Machine Gun,
- New **machine gun targets**,
- New **hIt indicators**.


=====

Known issues: teleporting may sometimes require two button presses.

Update 0.816: Handles & gunsmoke!

- New attachment type: handles!
- Also: gunsmoke effects, 
- model tweaks, 
- fps improvements!

V. 0.800:

- New SMG: the FN Herstal P90, 5.7x28!

- New burst/semi/auto fire mode - click right joystick for auto weapons to switch!

- New moveable stocks for M4, AR-15, Benelli, and SPAS.

- Snap turn setting moved to farmhouse settings board.

+++

- Pump shotgun spawn bug fixed.
V. 0786: Bug fix - Fixes for shotgun ammo bug and gun respawn bugs!
